notes.title: Release of 44 Master Grades
notes.content:
The core theme of the game, 44 Master Grades, has been released.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548136/d9cd9b81f13ee6e64b22d956b01d4737809553de.png"]

Master Grades must be crafted by combining three Legendary Grade equipment items and require an additional 3,000 gold.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548136/213f3cbe690528e8403306cb118bb9f617659ec8.png"]

The first combination requires 3,000 gold, but the cost increases to 8,000 gold for the second combination.

Initially, it was designed to allow only one Master purchase, but to enhance strategic diversity, multiple purchases are now possible.

However, to own more than one Master, a significant amount of gold is required, so you will need to save gold in other areas.

Various concept Master items are available, so strategically combine them and try to clear the game.




Simplification of Legendary Equipment Stats
Unlike before, where multiple stats were assigned to a single equipment item, the simplification of equipment stats now clarifies the concept.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548136/67d0a8b4189d99d667946b4743c65aaf17c8f66f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548136/8980df20faf41df110607af873a8c8c1c6683def.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548136/b18678371a6ae929bd748139a6eeaa264c4a0513.png"]

Each concept is broadly classified as follows:

Whether it can synergize with Master equipment

Whether it supports line damage

Whether it can quickly defeat bosses & elites

Whether it aids in survival


Removal of Health Recovery Potions
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548136/2716594d10122aaae963c37b4470020b9ef1c0d2.png"]

With the removal of health recovery potions, players must now secure recovery-related items themselves.

notes.title: Bug and Balance Patch
notes.content:
The following bugs have been identified and resolved:


 Skill sound playing even when mana is insufficient
 Loadout information resetting continuously
 Other gear being unintentionally sold when selling equipment


Additionally, the balance of Legendary skills has been adjusted overall.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Equipment Balance Changes
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where equipment items were occasionally not dropped during mining.
Adjusted the balance of several legendary equipment items.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
In-game damage analysis feature has been added.
 The damage of single-target current HP and missing HP skills on legendary equipment has been reduced by about 40% due to being excessively high.

notes.title: Fixed an issue
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the total number of basic grades and the availability of combination materials were not displayed correctly when selecting a game level again after playing a game.

notes.title: Announcement: Release Delay & Progress Update
notes.content:
We plan to release the full game along with a free demo version for players to try.
The demo version has been completed and is currently under Steam review, expected to be available in 3–5 days.
Accordingly, the full game is also scheduled for release in 3–5 days.


 Completed Tasks
[olist]
 Revised tutorial equipment descriptions
 Changed Equipment Shop UI to Equipment Codex UI
 Modified difficulty settings to allow toggling of the equipment combination interface in all difficulty levels
 Improved game clear UI
[/olist]



 In Progress
[olist]
 Damage analysis feature
 Display game result information even after losing
 Adjustments to equipment items and game balance
[/olist]

notes.title: Release Info & Roadmap
notes.content:
It’s already been two years since development began.  
We’re very excited to finally release the game on April 2nd.  
We sincerely thank everyone who has played the game.  
Now, we’d like to share the development roadmap going forward.

Roadmap

  
Game Release on April 2nd  
  
  
Mobile version (Android) planned for release in May–June  
  
  
44 Master-grade items to be released in the second half of 2025  


Most of the work on the mobile version is complete, but due to some effects not displaying properly, along with UI adjustments and optimization, we plan to finish these tasks before releasing.

Planned Improvements

We can’t give an exact timeline, but we are aware of the issues and plan to address them quickly.  
  
Equipment Shop UI → Will be replaced by Equipment Collection  
  
The current Equipment Shop has the collection on the left, and descriptions, composition, and inventory on the right,  
but we’ve decided the right section is unnecessary and will remove it, simplifying the UI so players can browse and combine items directly from the collection.

  
Tutorial  
  
We plan to shorten and revise the overly long tutorial along with the Equipment Shop UI update.
